build_RemoteClientState: build a RemoteClientState instance to track remote client input and messages for HITL simulation
get_gui_input: get the GuiInput object for a specified user index from the RemoteClientState
get_head_pose: get the head position and quaternion rotation for a user from recent client state history
get_hand_pose: get the hand position and quaternion rotation for a user and hand index from client state
kick_users: kick remote users matching a specified user mask by sending a kick signal to the networking thread
